mechanism_amplitude_check.reduction_reason_note: part of the barrier cost is already hidden under MTE pipeline overlap (case14 finding); conservative issue-cost model overestimates

local_verdict_scope: wide-FP32 change-domain (ProcessWideFp32FullCacheRows NORM-HOIST): primary 1x32768_fp32 (clean med -2.55%, 5/6), confirming 2x16384_fp32 (-2.65%, 4/6); 2x32768_fp32 recorded weak (-0.67%, window2) and not claimed
local_verdict_reason: Per 本地性能测试规范/实验总则 F the noise comparator is the change-domain shape's own paired noise range: 1x32768 paired-delta MAD 0.915% / SE 0.47%, and the window's systematic offset (control median +1.00%) is now below the +/-1.5% target. The effect (-2.55% clean, -2.63% all) stably exceeds both; direction consistent 5/6 in-window and 14/16 across three windows (sign-test p=0.002); mechanism amplitude same order (predicted 3.5-8.1%, measured 2.5-3.5%, reduction attributed to MTE-overlap absorption of barrier cost). Build/correctness/same-binary/identity all PASS. LOCAL_BEST advances to V001.
